title: Key (Inocente Bramm)
summary: Unlocks the Baldur’s Mouth balcony back door at X 39, Y −52.

fields.Acquisition: Guard Inocente Bramm carries it. A DC 15 Sleight of Hand check also opens the back door.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
